violations.text: Deli meats and cheeses were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026

The door to the outside, located in the basement, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026

The floors in the bathroom and behind the chest freezer were observed with an accumulation of rodent droppings. The physical facilities must be cleaned as often as necessary. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026

The following areas were observed as possible entry points for pests: 1) The plumbing behind the grease trap was observed with gaps. 2) The plumbing in the bathroom near the toilet and sink were observed with gaps. The areas must be repaired/filled/treated to prevent the entry of pests. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2026
